thread:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — Aurelia Health sent back a CAIQ and wants answers for Dedicated + Private deploy in EU only. Deadline: next Wed COB. They also asked about BYO-HSM (PKCS#11), pentest reports, and SCPs for cross-account access. I uploaded the CAIQ to the intake queue. @Nadia could you own?

intake-bot: New intake created: SEC-2027. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2027
Attachment: aurelia-ca iq-2026.pdf
Labels: sig, private-deploy, eu-only

Nadia (Security): I can pick this up. Quick note: we need to confirm whether they require Redwood-managed keys ever or strictly BYO-HSM for the PoC. Also need their contact for infra diagrams.

Maya (AE): They said BYO-HSM during PoC but may accept Redwood-managed keys later. Infra lead is lucas@aurelia.health. I scheduled a 30m sync with Lucas for Tuesday 09:00 CET. Calendar: https://cal.aurelia/lucas

Jon (PS): For the private deployment checklist — we'll need expected CIDR ranges, allowed egress ports, and whether they require peering or AWS Transit. I can draft sample SGs and a short VPC runbook for Lucas.

intake-bot: CAIQ parse complete: 54 questions. 36 auto-matched, 18 require manual inputs. Highlighted: key management, pentest evidence, vulnerability scanning cadence, incident response contacts. Missing: network diagram, pentest summary, SOC2 link.

Nadia (Security): Uploaded baseline answers to SEC-2027 (auto-matched ones). I'll work on the 18 manual items. Plan: 24-36h for draft responses. Need to loop in Legal for any contract/KMS language.

Eli (Legal): FYI I'll review any KMS addendum language. If they're asking for contractual controls around key custody, we might need a short addendum; I'll prepare a template.

Jon (PS): Draft runbook ETA tomorrow EOD. I'll include port list: 443 outbound, 1024-65535 ephemeral, 500/4500 for IPsec if needed. Also include sample peering steps for AWS and GCP.

Nadia (Security): Draft answer snippets (please skim):
``
Q: Do you support BYO-HSM?
A: Yes. For private deployments we support customer-provided HSMs via PKCS#11-compatible interfaces. We provide an integration guide and test harness; keys are never exported by Redwood.

Q: Pentest evidence?
A: We provide our most recent third-party penetration test summary and remediation tracker under NDA. We can also provide SOC 2 Type II report to authorized contacts.
``

Maya (AE): Looks good. Lucas requested explicit statement on vulnerability scanning cadence (how often do you scan infra/components?).

Nadia (Security): Reply draft: we run internal automated vulnerability scans weekly, authenticated scans monthly on critical assets, and annual third-party penetration tests. Critical security patches applied per our patching policy (48-72h for high severity).

intake-bot: SEC-2027 status: assigned -> Nadia (Security). Auto-answered -> 36, manual -> 18. Next reminder: 24 hours.

Eli (Legal): Uploading KMS addendum template to SEC-2027 comments.

Nadia (Security): Next steps: 1) Receive network diagram from Lucas; 2) Attach SOC2 link (I have redwood-soc2-2025.pdf ready); 3) Finalize 18 manual answers and send to Maya for review before publishing. If Lucas doesn't provide diagrams, we'll send a needs-info response with 12 answered items and a checklist for missing inputs.

Maya (AE): Thanks team. I'll join the Tuesday sync and push Lucas for the diagram. Mark any outstanding blockers in SEC-2027 so we can keep single source of truth. :pray:
